name: Reads Into Jumpers
summary: Warm up your handle, make quick reads off a coin flip, score off a pass fake, then finish tired at the rim.

drills.name: Low Shuffle Dribbles
drills.summary: Keep a hard, low dribble while your feet slide side to side.
steps: Get in a low stance at the baseline.
Shuffle sideways to the lane line while pounding the ball with your right hand.
Shuffle back with your left hand.
Keep your feet wide. Never cross them.
Last minute, add a crossover each time you change direction.

drills.name: Coin Flip Attack Reads
drills.summary: Attack the rim and let a coin flip tell you whether help comes.
steps: Put a cone in the lane as the help defender.
Start at the wing in triple threat. Flip the coin and don't look yet.
Drive hard to the cone, then check the coin.
Heads, help came: jump stop and pivot out to pass. Tails, no help: finish the layup.
Say your read out loud before you make the play.

drills.name: Pass-Fake Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Sell a pass to move the defense, then rip into a one-dribble pull-up.
steps: Set a cone at the free throw line extended.
Start at the top. Make a hard pass fake to the wing with your eyes and arms.
Rip the ball low and take one hard dribble toward the cone.
Stop on balance and shoot the pull-up.
Rebound, go back to the top and fake the other way.

drills.name: Half-Court Turn Layups
drills.summary: Finish at the rim, sprint to half court and back, then finish again tired.
steps: Start at the right wing and make a right-hand layup.
Grab the ball and speed dribble to half court.
Turn at half court and attack the left side for a left-hand layup.
Keep going for 45 seconds, then rest 15 seconds.
Count your makes each round and try to beat it.
